book.name: MATEO
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U TIO Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Mateo tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Ni toksal ok u Jesús vatz u Poncio Pilato
As tul sajbꞌu veꞌteꞌ, as ikꞌul veꞌt tibꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ. As ikꞌul veꞌt tibꞌ iyol chajnaj uvaꞌ techal la yatzꞌpu veꞌt u Jesús.
As iqitz veꞌt chajnaj iqꞌabꞌ Aak. As teqꞌo veꞌt ok chajnaj Aak vatz u Poncio Pilato uvaꞌ nik bꞌanon ivatz u ijlenaaleꞌ.
Nikam uveꞌ u Judas

As tul til u Judas uvaꞌ kꞌayin u Jesús uvaꞌ la yatzꞌpu veꞌt u Jesús, as ijalpu veꞌt naj vitxumbꞌaleꞌ. As bꞌex iqꞌaavisa veꞌt kan naj vinaj laval u puajeꞌ te unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ.

Ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ te chajnaj: —Kat paavinyu veꞌt in, tan yeꞌl ipaav u najeꞌ ati. As kat kuxh voksa ok naj teqꞌabꞌ,— tiꞌk u Judas. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¿At kol qokebꞌal qꞌa stiꞌ? Pet axh kuxheꞌ la ilon kam tuk abꞌaneꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As isuti veꞌt kan u Judas u puajeꞌ tu u tostiixheꞌ. As bꞌen veꞌt naj. As ichꞌuybꞌaꞌ veꞌt tibꞌ naj. As kam veꞌt naj.

As isikꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh u puajeꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —Yeꞌ la uch qoksat ok u puajeꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa oyeꞌ uvaꞌ at tu u kaaxhaeꞌ, tan kajal nixaan taꞌn u puajeꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.

As tul bꞌaꞌnxi tiꞌ ikꞌulat tibꞌ iyol chajnaj, as bꞌex iloqꞌ veꞌt chajnaj umaꞌl u txꞌavaꞌ xeꞌ umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ ni bꞌanon tzꞌaj laj. As txakonsal veꞌt u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ mujbꞌal tetz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ jit tiaal Israel.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ nitel talpu cheel uvaꞌ tiꞌ kajal loqꞌpukat u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
As bꞌex ibꞌan veꞌt umaꞌt u yol uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ Jeremías, tan ech tal u Jeremías ileꞌ:

content.text: As teqꞌo veꞌt chajnaj vinaj laval u puajeꞌ, vijaꞌmil umaꞌl u uxhchil uvaꞌ nim talchu xoꞌl unqꞌa tiaal Israel, tan ech vijaꞌmileꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujlu kan taꞌn unqꞌa tiaal Israel.
As kat txakonsali tiꞌ iloqꞌax vitxꞌavaꞌ umaꞌl u bꞌanol tzꞌaj laj echeꞌ uveꞌ kat tal u kuBꞌooqꞌoleꞌ sve, tiꞌk u Jeremías.

content: Nichꞌoti veꞌt u Poncio Pilato itziꞌ u Jesús

As tul txaklik veꞌt ok u Jesús vatz u bꞌanol ivatz u ijlenaaleꞌ, as ichꞌoti veꞌt naj itziꞌ Aak. Ech tal naj ileꞌ: —¿Ma axh u tijlenaal unqꞌa tiaal Israel?— tiꞌk naj. Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —An chiteꞌ uveꞌ naaleꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As kꞌuxh nikat icheesa unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh ipaav u Jesús, as yeꞌl Aak kat tzaqꞌbꞌi.
As ech tal veꞌt u Poncio Pilato ileꞌ te Aak: —¿Ma yeꞌ naabꞌi unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni tal chajnaj seeꞌ?— tiꞌk naj.
As sotz veꞌt ikꞌuꞌl naj, tan jit tal u Jesús umaj yol.
Ni talax veꞌt ikam u Jesús
As tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ pascua, as chiannalik veꞌt te unqꞌa tenameꞌ taꞌn u bꞌanol ivatz u ijlenaaleꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ la txaaon umaj preexhu uvaꞌ la chajpuli.
As atik ok umaꞌl u naj preexhuil uvaꞌ Barrabás. As ootzimalik vipaav najeꞌ taꞌn unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

As tul molik tibꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ vatz u Pilato, as ichꞌoti veꞌt naj te unqꞌa tenameꞌ: —¿Abꞌiste u najeꞌ la unchajpu el cheel? ¿Ma aꞌ u Barrabás? ¿Pet moj aꞌ u Jesús uveꞌ Cristo nitalpeꞌ?— tiꞌk u Pilato,
tan atik skꞌuꞌl u Pilato uvaꞌ taꞌn kuxh chꞌoꞌnchil aama nikat toksakat unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ u Jesús tiqꞌabꞌ u Pilato.

As tul xonlik u Pilato tu vixhiila uvaꞌ nibꞌanaxkat isuuchil unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as ichaj bꞌen u tixqel najeꞌ yol. Ech tal bꞌen ixoj ileꞌ: «Yeꞌ kuxh achuk apaav tiꞌ u jikla najeꞌ, tan kalabꞌ chit kꞌaxkꞌo kat unpalebꞌe tunvatzikꞌ tiꞌ u najeꞌ,» tiꞌk u tixqel najeꞌ.
As unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ, as toksa veꞌt chajnaj tiviꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ u Barrabás la chajpuli, as la yatzꞌpu u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —¿Abꞌiste kaꞌvaꞌl u najeꞌ la unchajpu el uveꞌ netaleꞌ?— tiꞌk naj. Ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa tenam ileꞌ: —Chajpu el tzan u Barrabás,— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —¿Kam qꞌi tuk unbꞌan tiꞌ u Jesús uveꞌ Cristo ni talpeꞌ?— tiꞌk u Pilato. As kajayil chit unqꞌa tenameꞌ kat alon: —¡Yatzꞌpoj naj vatz u kuruseꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

As ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —¿Kam ipaav u najeꞌ qꞌi kat ibꞌana?— tiꞌk u Pilato. As aal chit taqꞌ jeꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tuul iviꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ: —¡Yatzꞌpoj naj vatz u kuruseꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

As til veꞌt u Pilato uvaꞌ yeꞌ nik tok veꞌt yol tiviꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ. Pet aal chit nik iveqꞌelkabꞌan unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As ijaj veꞌt u Pilato unbꞌiil u aꞌ. As itxꞌaa veꞌt naj iqꞌabꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ. Ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —Yeꞌl unpaav tiꞌ vikamebꞌal u jikla najeꞌ, tan exeꞌ ni alon ikameꞌ,— tiꞌk u Pilato.
Ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa tenam ileꞌ skajayil: —¡Jeꞌonoj u kupaaveꞌ sqiꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa meꞌal kukꞌaoleꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌeneꞌ tiꞌ vikamebꞌal u najeꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
Ichajpu veꞌt u Pilato u Barrabás. As tal veꞌt naj iqꞌospu u Jesús taꞌn tzꞌuꞌm. As tul bꞌaꞌnxi, as taqꞌ veꞌt ok naj u Jesús te unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ iyatzꞌpu veꞌt Aak vatz u kuruseꞌ.

As unqꞌa isol u bꞌanol ivatz u ijlenaaleꞌ, as teqꞌo veꞌt chajnaj u Jesús tikabꞌal u bꞌanol ivatz u ijlenaaleꞌ uvaꞌ atikkat u tatinbꞌal unqꞌa soleꞌ. As imol veꞌt ok unqꞌa imooleꞌ skajayil kꞌatz u Jesús.
As teesa veꞌt unqꞌa soleꞌ u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ. As toksa veꞌt chajnaj umaꞌl u kaj oksaꞌm tiꞌ Aak echeꞌ toksaꞌm umaj ijlenaal.

As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ chajnaj umaꞌl u koroona chꞌiꞌx tiꞌ iviꞌ Aak uvaꞌ paatxꞌumalike. As taqꞌoꞌk chajnaj umaꞌl u aa tisebꞌal iqꞌabꞌ Aak echeꞌ ibꞌaara umaj ijlenaal. As qaaebꞌ veꞌt chajnaj vatz Aak tiꞌ teesal iqꞌii Aak. As ech tal chajnaj ileꞌ te Aak: —¡Keche, Pap, axh tijlenaal unqꞌa tiaal Israel!— tiꞌk chajnaj tul nikat teesa chajnaj iqꞌii Aak.
As itzubꞌa veꞌt chajnaj Aak. As imaa chajnaj u aaeꞌ tiqꞌabꞌ Aak. As ivekꞌ chajnaj tiꞌ iviꞌ Aak.
As tul maꞌtik teesat chajnaj iqꞌii Aak, as teesa veꞌt el chajnaj u kaj oksaꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ Aak. As toksa veꞌt chajnaj u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ. As teqꞌo veꞌt chajnaj Aak tiꞌ iyatzꞌpu vatz u kuruseꞌ.
Ni taqꞌpik jeꞌ u Jesús vatz u kurus
As tul bꞌen veꞌt chajnaj tu bꞌey, as ikꞌul chajnaj umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ Simón uvaꞌ tzaanaj tu u Cirene. As itxey veꞌt chajnaj u Simón tiꞌ uvaꞌ la tija naj vikurus u Jesús.
Tul oon veꞌt chajnaj tu umaꞌl u atinbꞌal uvaꞌ Gólgota ibꞌii uvaꞌ «Tatinbꞌal Bꞌajil Kꞌoꞌn» chꞌelel,
as taqꞌ veꞌt chajnaj unbꞌiil u taꞌl uuva te u Jesús uvaꞌ yuelik tibꞌ tukꞌ kꞌayla aꞌ. As tul inach Aak, as jit tukꞌa veꞌt Aak.

As tul maꞌt taqꞌat veꞌt jeꞌ unqꞌa soleꞌ u Jesús vatz u kuruseꞌ, as ijatx veꞌt chajnaj u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ svatzaj. As itxꞌak veꞌt tibꞌ chajnaj tiꞌ u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ, tiꞌ itzojpisal umaꞌl u yol uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ u Jesús uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Ijatx veꞌt chajnaj u voksaꞌmeꞌ svatzaj.
As itxꞌak veꞌt tibꞌ chajnaj stiꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ.

content: Tul bꞌaꞌnxi, as xonebꞌ veꞌt chajnaj tiꞌ ixeep Aak.
As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ chajnaj umaꞌl u aqꞌen tiviꞌ u kuruseꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamalikkat uvaꞌ kam stiꞌ nikat iyatzꞌpukat Aak. Ech nik tal ileꞌ: Aꞌ U JESÚS UVAꞌ, U TIJLENAAL UNQꞌA TIAAL ISRAEL, tiꞌk u tzꞌibꞌeꞌ.
As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ chajnaj kaꞌvaꞌl unqꞌa elqꞌomeꞌ vatz kaꞌvaꞌt unqꞌa kuruseꞌ. Umaꞌl naj jeꞌ tisebꞌal u Jesús; as umaꞌt naj jeꞌ timax Aak.
As jankꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ nikat ipaleꞌ, as nik iyiku veꞌt iviꞌ tul nikat iyoqꞌon tiꞌ u Jesús.

As ech nik tal ileꞌ: —Nikat aaleꞌ uvaꞌ la eꞌpisa u tostiixheꞌ as titoxvu qꞌii la alak unpajte, uvaꞌ naaleꞌ. Asoj axh viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ uveꞌ naaleꞌ, as qꞌalpu eebꞌ vatz u kamchileꞌ scheel. As kuꞌen chꞌuꞌl vatz u kuruseꞌ,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.

As echat chit nik ibꞌan unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh, tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ chusel tibꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tzaqꞌiteꞌ, as tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaal tenameꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ tiꞌ u Jesús:

—As kꞌuxh kat iqꞌalpu naj unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ vatz unqꞌa chꞌoꞌmeꞌ, as yeꞌ nitxꞌol veꞌt naj iqꞌalput tibꞌ vatz u kuruseꞌ. Asoj naj u qijlenaaleꞌ, as kuꞌoj chꞌuꞌl naj vatz u kuruseꞌ cheel. As aꞌn la kunima veꞌt naj.
As kat tal naj sqe uvaꞌ naj iKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ. Asoj kꞌujleꞌl ikꞌuꞌl naj tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ, as iloch u Tiixheꞌ bꞌa naj cheel, asoj nisaꞌ u Tiixheꞌ naj,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As echat nikat ibꞌan unqꞌa elqꞌomeꞌ uveꞌ atik jeꞌ vatz unqꞌa kuruseꞌ kꞌatz u Jesús, tan antik chajnaj nik iyoqꞌon tiꞌ Aak.
As tul chaqꞌaan veꞌt qꞌii, as tokin veꞌt ivatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As techanal oon veꞌt oxvaꞌl oora kuꞌqꞌii, as aꞌn ilon veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ unpajte.

Tul bꞌiitik kuxh toon veꞌt oxvaꞌl oora kuꞌqꞌii, as sikꞌin veꞌt u Jesús. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —¿Elí, Elí, lama sabactani?— tiꞌk Aak. Aꞌ isuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ «¡Kubꞌaal Tiixh, Kubꞌaal Tiixh! ¿Kam qꞌi uveꞌ nu kuxh aaqꞌ kan in sunjunal?» tiꞌk Aak.
As kaꞌl unqꞌa uxhchil uvaꞌ atik tzitziꞌ, as tul tabꞌi isikꞌin u Jesús, as ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ svatzaj: —Aꞌ u Elías nimolo naj,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As oora chit bꞌex teqꞌo veꞌt tzan umaꞌl u naj umaꞌl u patxkin kꞌoo. As takꞌsa naj taꞌn kꞌayla taꞌl uuva. As ikꞌaloꞌk naj tijuꞌ umaꞌl u aa. As taqꞌ jeꞌ naj te u Jesús aqꞌal uvaꞌ la tukꞌa Aak.
Ech tal veꞌt kaꞌt unqꞌa imool naj ileꞌ ste: —Yeꞌ eetz tiꞌ naj. Tuk qileꞌ ma tuk uloj u Elías tiꞌ iqꞌalpul naj,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As sikꞌin veꞌt u Jesús unpajte. As taqꞌ veꞌt ok Aak u taanxelaleꞌ te u Tiixheꞌ. As kam veꞌt Aak.

As qꞌixmu veꞌt u nimla ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ uveꞌ nik jatxon tuul u tostiixheꞌ. As kaꞌvaꞌl kuꞌ u ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ stuul, tan kat qꞌixmik kuꞌ tzan tiviꞌ as kat ul xeꞌ toj. As ul veꞌt umaꞌl u kabꞌlaano. As eꞌp veꞌt unqꞌa sivaneꞌ staꞌn.
As ijaj veꞌt tibꞌ unqꞌa juleꞌ vatz u piꞌuneꞌ uveꞌ mujikkat unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ. As nimal unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ ul veꞌt taama uveꞌ nimanik tetz u Tiixheꞌ.

As tul maꞌtik tul veꞌt taama u Jesús, as el veꞌt chꞌuꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tu u juleꞌ. As ok veꞌt tu u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ txaael taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ Jerusalén. As nimal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ kat ilon unqꞌa kamnajeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ul taama.

Viqꞌesal unqꞌa soleꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa isol najeꞌ uvaꞌ nik xeen u Jesús, as tul til chajnaj u kabꞌlaanoeꞌ tukꞌ uvaꞌ kat til chajnaj tul kat kam Aak, as vaꞌlik chit ixoꞌv veꞌt chajnaj. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ svatzaj: —An chiteꞌ vil. IKꞌaol Tiixheꞌ vil u najeꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As nimal unqꞌa ixojeꞌ atik tzitziꞌ uvaꞌ locholik tetz Aak tul sitzaa Aak tu u Galilea. As tziꞌaꞌn kuxh nikat isajinkat veꞌt tzan unqꞌa ixojeꞌ tiꞌ Aak tul uvaꞌ sikam veꞌt Aak.
Antik u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ tzaanaj tu u tenam uvaꞌ Magdala, tukꞌ umaꞌt u Maꞌleꞌ, vitxutx u Jacob tukꞌ u Xhuꞌleꞌ, as tukꞌ vitxutx unqꞌa ikꞌaol u Zebedeo.
Nimujlu veꞌt u Jesús
As tul bꞌiitik ikuꞌ qꞌii, as bꞌex veꞌt umaꞌl u txꞌioliqꞌii uvaꞌ Xhuꞌl xeꞌ u Pilato. As aꞌ tzaanajkat u Xhuꞌleꞌ tu u tenam uvaꞌ Arimatea. As nimamalik u Jesús taꞌn naj.
As bꞌex ijaj veꞌt naj vichiꞌol u Jesús te u Pilato. As tal veꞌt u Pilato te unqꞌa isoleꞌ uvaꞌ la aqꞌax vichiꞌol Aakeꞌ te u Xhuꞌleꞌ.
As teqꞌo veꞌt kuꞌ tzan u Xhuꞌleꞌ vichiꞌol Aakeꞌ. As ibꞌoch veꞌt naj tu umaꞌl u saj maanta.
As bꞌex imuj veꞌt kan naj tu umaꞌl u jul uvaꞌ aꞌn kꞌotik ok vatz umaꞌl u piꞌun. As tul maꞌtik ibꞌalqꞌut veꞌt ok naj umaꞌl u nimla sivan tziꞌ u juleꞌ, as bꞌen veꞌt naj.
As u Maꞌleꞌ uvaꞌ tzaanaj tu u tenam uvaꞌ Magdala, as xonlik kuxh tziꞌ u juleꞌ tukꞌ umaꞌt u Maꞌleꞌ.
Nixeep veꞌt u jul uveꞌ mujlukat u Jesús
As ech eꞌtal stuul, tul paly veꞌt u qꞌii uveꞌ ni bꞌanaxkat tuch u nimla qꞌiieꞌ, as imol veꞌt tibꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ unqꞌa fariseo vatz u Pilato.
Ech bꞌex tal chajnaj ileꞌ: —Pap, tul qal see, tan kat ul sukukꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ tul yeꞌxnik kam u chulin yoleꞌ, as kat tal naj uvaꞌ titoxvu qꞌii la ul taama naj unpajte.

Estiꞌeꞌ tul kujaj bꞌaꞌnil see uvaꞌ la achaj bꞌen kaꞌoj unqꞌa soleꞌ tiꞌ ixeep u juleꞌ uvaꞌ kat mujlukat naj. As lanal pal oxvaꞌl u qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ imujlu naj, tan la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ la oon unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ najeꞌ tiꞌ bꞌen telqꞌat vichiꞌol najeꞌ. As la bꞌen tal veꞌt chajnaj te unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ kat ulyu taama naj unpajte. As la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ nim la bꞌenkat u chuli yoleꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa chuli yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat tal u najeꞌ bꞌaxa,— tiꞌk chajnaj te u Pilato.
Ech tal veꞌt u Pilato ileꞌ: —Il kaꞌl unqꞌa sol ileꞌ. Eteqꞌotaj chajnaj tiꞌ ixeep u juleꞌ echeꞌ uveꞌ netaleꞌ,— tiꞌk u Pilato.
As bꞌex toksa veꞌt kan unqꞌa iqꞌesal u tenameꞌ umaꞌl u exhlal tiꞌ u sivaneꞌ uvaꞌ nik jupun itziꞌ u juleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil la jajon. As taqꞌ veꞌt kan chajnaj unqꞌa soleꞌ tiꞌ ixeep itziꞌ u juleꞌ.
